s: eternal life is received by beloved brethren (those who repent and keep God's commandments)
q: And whosoever doeth this, and keepeth the commandments of God from thenceforth, the same will remember that I say unto him, yea, he will remember that I have said unto him, he shall have eternal life

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: kingdom of God is inherited by those born again
q: if ye are not born again ye cannot inherit the kingdom of heaven

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: kingdom of God does not receive filthiness (or anything unclean)
q: neither can filthiness or anything which is unclean be received into the kingdom of God

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: faith in Christ is required with hope
q: And see that ye have faith, hope, and charity

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: beloved brethren is humbled before God
q: I should find that ye had humbled yourselves before God

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: hope is required with charity
q: And see that ye have faith, hope, and charity

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: charity leads to good works (with faith and hope)
q: And see that ye have faith, hope, and charity, and then ye will always abound in good works.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Jacob is with prophets (in the kingdom of heaven)
q: that ye may at last be brought to sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the holy prophets who have been ever since the world began

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: peace of God rests upon beloved brethren (according to their faith and good works)
q: may the peace of God rest upon you, and upon your houses and lands, and upon your flocks and herds, and all that you possess, your women and your children, according to your faith and good works

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: beloved brethren continues the supplicating of his grace
q: that ye had continued in the supplicating of his grace, that I should find that ye were blameless before him

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: brethren at Zarahemla is established in way of his righteousness (again)
q: hath given unto me the exceedingly great joy of knowing that they are established again in the way of his righteousness

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zarahemla has brethren at Zarahemla
q: the brethren at Zarahemla

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: God is a true and living God
q: do not worship idols, but that ye do worship the true and living God

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: God has power to do all things (according to his word)
q: the Lord God hath power to do all things which are according to his word.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma is a high priest (over the church)
q: I am Alma, and am the high priest over the church of God throughout the land.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the land of Melek is located west of river Sidon (on the west by the borders of the wilderness)
q: the land of Melek, on the west of the river Sidon, on the west by the borders of the wilderness.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma visits land of Ammonihah (after traveling three days north of Melek)
q: he departed thence, and traveled three days’ journey on the north of the land of Melek; and he came to a city which was called Ammonihah.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: land of Ammonihah is a city (of the people of Nephi)
q: and he came to a city which was called Ammonihah.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: land of Ammonihah is named after the first possessor of the land (according to the custom of the people of Nephi)
q: Now it was the custom of the people of Nephi to call their lands, and their cities, and their villages, yea, even all their small villages, after the name of him who first possessed them; and thus it was with the land of Ammonihah.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: preaching is conducted in land of Ammonihah (preaching the word of God)
q: when Alma had come to the city of Ammonihah he began to preach the word of God unto them.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the people who were in the city of Ammonihah are influenced by Satan (Satan has great hold upon their hearts)
q: Now Satan had gotten great hold upon the hearts of the people of the city of Ammonihah

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the people who were in the city of Ammonihah reject preaching (they will not hearken to Alma's words)
q: therefore they would not hearken unto the words of Alma.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma establishes church (in many parts of the land)
q: Behold, we know that thou art Alma; and we know that thou art high priest over the church which thou hast established in many parts of the land, according to your tradition;

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma's prayer is offered to God (mighty prayer in the spirit)
q: Alma labored much in the spirit, wrestling with God in mighty prayer

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma's prayer seeks the Spirit of the Lord (for the people in Ammonihah)
q: that he would pour out his Spirit upon the people who were in the city

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma's rejection and expulsion from Ammonihah is caused by the people who were in the city of Ammonihah (they withstand, revile, spit upon, and cast him out)
q: withstood all his words, and reviled him, and spit upon him, and caused that he should be cast out of their city

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma's rejection and expulsion from Ammonihah occurs in land of Ammonihah (the city)
q: caused that he should be cast out of their city

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the angel's message to Alma is delivered by angel of the Lord (while Alma is journeying toward Aaron)
q: behold an angel of the Lord appeared unto him, saying:

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: angel of the Lord delivers the angel's message to Alma (to Alma)
q: behold an angel of the Lord appeared unto him, saying:
